tasks.short: Outline security criteria for pre-bid meetings.

steps.what: Outline system security criteria for the pre-bid
Ensure comprehensiveness and appropriateness for implementation
Hold the pre-bid meetings with clients and companies

outputs: filed copy of signed pre-bid criteria v1

tasks.design: The specialist outlines the system security criteria, checks that they are comprehensive and appropriate for implementation, and holds the pre-bid meetings with clients and companies. A job sends the criteria from {EMAIL} only after that version is signed. The job does not speak at the meeting.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generated criterion list could be sent as the brief.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed pack can be sent to the companies that attended.
tasks.still_hard: What the criteria should require is still a judgement, tested in the meeting.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist outlines the criteria and signs them.

ambition.what: Send the criteria the same day as the meeting, and only the signed version.

tasks.altitude: The outline and the meeting stay. Sending the signed pack shrinks.

reach.task: Bid against only the signed criteria

evidence.claim: The operations digest says a draft must work from approved sources, and a named person signs.

assumptions: The job does not bid or negotiate.
unknowns: Who else must approve the criteria.
research_questions: How often the meeting changes a criterion.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the outline is the writing itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the stored standard list or the drawing index when it changes, and clear drafts the specialist rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the specialist still writes the criteria and holds the meeting. The high end assumes only the signed send is no longer done by hand. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor tapes and recordings to identify the source of losses.

steps.what: List stored tapes and digital recordings
Monitor the tapes and digital recordings
Identify the source of the losses from that watching

outputs: filed copy of signed loss finding v1

tasks.design: A job lists tapes and digital recordings already stored in {DOCS}. The specialist monitors those recordings and identifies the source of the losses. They sign the finding. A job files that version. The job does not watch, recognize a face, or score how a person looks. An automated watch of named staff is not built.
tasks.previous_blocker: A label on a recording could name a person before anyone had watched.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored recordings can be listed for the specialist to open.
tasks.still_hard: What the pictures show is still seen by the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist watches and signs what they identify.
tasks.altitude: The watching stays. Listing the stored recordings shrinks.

reach.learn: That the list is not an identification

evidence.claim: Digest [S19] bans emotion recognition at work since 2 February 2025, so a recording is not scored for how a person looks or sounds.
Digest [S20] bars a solely automated decision with significant effect, so a finding about a person stays with the specialist.
Digest [S21] says a score a decision-maker draws strongly on counts as the decision, so this design produces no threat score and no score of a person.
Digest [S22] says a data protection assessment is mandatory for employee monitoring, so an automated watch of named staff is not built.
Digest [S23] says works-council consent is required before staff monitoring, so this design does not add a view of named staff.

assumptions: No face or emotion score is produced.
A new automated watch would be a separate assessment and is not this job.
unknowns: How long they may be kept.
research_questions: How often the index names a recording that will not play.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the watching is the watching itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the stored standard list or the drawing index when it changes, and clear drafts the specialist rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the specialist still watches the recordings. The high end assumes only the index of stored recordings is no longer kept by hand. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Install, maintain, or repair security and control systems.

steps.what: Engineer and install the security systems
Maintain or repair programmable logic controls

outputs: filed copy of signed maintenance note v1

tasks.design: Engineering, installing, maintaining, and repairing security systems, programmable logic controls, and other security-related electronic systems stays with the specialist, on the equipment. A job files the note in {DOCS} only after they sign it. The job does not change a live control.
tasks.previous_blocker: A remote change could alter a control nobody had signed.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed note can record what was done on the equipment.
tasks.still_hard: The work is on the equipment, with the specialist present.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist does the work and signs the note.
tasks.altitude: The work stays. Filing the signed note shrinks.

reach.learn: That the file did not change the control

evidence.claim: Digest [S20] bars a solely automated decision with significant effect, so a finding about a person stays with the specialist.

assumptions: The job does not install, program, or repair.
unknowns: Which controls the specialist may change.
Whether a second person must watch a live change.
research_questions: How often a fault is not on the drawing.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the repair is the work itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the stored standard list or the drawing index when it changes, and clear drafts the specialist rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the specialist still does the work on the equipment. The high end assumes only the signed note is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The security specialist spends the week on the site, the incident, and the decision. Filing a signed note can move. No model scores a person, watches staff, or changes a live security system.
reach: A client sees only the criteria or the finding the specialist signed.
A supervisor gets an emergency note after the specialist has already responded.
skills_to_grow: Tell a stored incident count from a threat decision.
Refuse a view that scores or tracks named staff.
role.ambitious_version: A signed test or a signed recommendation can be filed the same day, and the specialist still decides it.
